fields.name: name
fields.label: Category Name
fields.description: The display name for this discipline (e.g. 3D Modeling, Graphic Design, Brand Identity).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Category Summary
fields.description: A clear overview of the creative services and deliverables in this category.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: Key Tools & Software
fields.description: Add software or techniques used (e.g. Blender, 3ds Max, Photoshop, CorelDRAW).

fields.label: URL Slug (Advanced / Auto-generated)

fields.label: Display Order Number (Optional)

fields.name: title
fields.label: Project Title

fields.description: Click to upload a high-resolution photo, 3D render, or graphic design image for this exhibit.
